text.tspan: Terraform compares three things: code, state and the real cloud
AWS API: S3, EKS, RDS, IAM…
Every question in these notes is about one of these arrows.
Drift = real ≠ state. Pending change = code ≠ state. Import = real object not yet in state.
The state file is the heart: protect it (remote backend + lock + encryption + versioning).
